en.headline: 406 own commits across 11 repos, 4 skill releases and 40 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode skill tooling: skill management, a model picker, an agent sandbox and a translation extension. Upstream bug reports filled the rest.
en.overview:
The window was dominated by OpenCode skill tooling. The `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` profile repository carried 127 own commits plus 713 automated commits, mostly documentation work: Excalidraw flow diagrams for the push pipeline and Cloudflare Workers Builds, an ops index, and a watchdog feature that extends the fallback scope to a second workflow with its own timeline.

`opencode-skill-management` shipped the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, plus a spec revision and feasibility review. It went through release candidates published by CI via trusted publishing and OIDC, then reached v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 (JSON tool output with a declared schema) and v1.2.0 (fixes to the divergence summary and frontmatter boolean parsing).

`opencode-go-model-picker` moved from v1.4.0 to v2.0.0 and v3.0.0/3.0.1. Work covered shared script helpers for BOM-safe atomic JSON writes and proxy re-runs, fuller agent discovery with `skippedBuiltins`, priced accounting in `quota-math`, and a large documentation reduction in 3.0.0. 3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu and re-derived numbers in `check`.

`opencode-agent-sandbox` built a `knowledge/` base for Git, GitHub and OpenCode findings, including V2 distribution, auth and Windows path pitfalls, with AGENTS.md conventions. `sopen-translate` grew an MV3 extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, provider presets and a glossary pipeline, then dropped selection translation and added JSDoc type checking and smoke tests.

`pixel-logo-toolkit` released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and a 40-image command gallery; Korean switched to Galmuri after Ark Pixel's ko build turned out to lack Hangul. Smaller work: `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5, `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples, and `meld-deepresearch` added a bilingual run-flow sketch.

Upstream, 23 issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` (storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card and file-view bugs) and 11 to `anomalyco/opencode` (MiMo vision and image-input failures, Windows CLI access, worktree removal). No pull requests or reviews were recorded.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x after release candidates published through CI trusted publishing.
v3.0.0 cut the model-facing documentation from 104,181 to 8,291 characters.
v0.3.0 added automatic CJK-aware line wrapping and proportional font-size fallback on overflow.
v1.1.0 changed all four actions to return one JSON object validated against a declared output schema.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a report that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images with 400.
Started an idea discussion to comment on selected code rather than only selected line numbers in the Files view.
Opened and closed a temporary opencode /oc smoke test issue.

byRepo.text: 127 own commits plus 713 automated commits and 6 issue actions. Documentation work rebuilt the push-flow diagrams with Excalidraw, added an ops index and a Workers Builds watchdog note, and a watchdog feature extended fallback coverage to the 30-day activity card workflow.

77 commits and 4 releases. Implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable, revised the spec, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings, and shipped v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0.

80 commits. Started from an initial commit and built a `knowledge/` archive covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and auth, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim findings, and remote branch deletion risks, with AGENTS.md conventions.

56 commits. Built an MV3 extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, added a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, then removed selection translation and added JSDoc checking and smoke tests.

29 commits and 2 releases. Added automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image example gallery, and a Korean font fix; released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0.

25 commits and 4 releases. Added shared script helpers for atomic BOM-safe JSON writes and proxy re-runs, expanded agent discovery output, added priced accounting in `quota-math`, and shipped v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1.

0 commits and 23 issue actions. Reported bugs on MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view line selection, context panel breakdown, capture resolution and model switching, and started idea discussions on code selection comments and sharing session archive state.
0 commits and 11 issue actions. Reported MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision and image-input failures, subagent model_coming_soon errors, missing Windows CLI access, and commented on worktree removal recovery.
6 commits. Corrected skill invocation facts across the skill, samples, guides and contributor docs, fixed Japanese localization, and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5.
4 commits. Added OpenChamber capture samples at desktop, panel and mobile sizes plus a session retention hint screenshot.
2 commits. Added a bilingual hand-drawn Excalidraw run-flow sketch split into English and Chinese scenes and wired the figures into the README.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库 406 次本人提交，4 个技能发布与 40 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 本期主要投入 OpenCode 技能工具链：技能管理、模型选择器、Agent 沙箱与翻译扩展，其余为上游项目的缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本期工作集中在 OpenCode 技能工具链。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 个人主页仓库有 127 次本人提交，另有 713 次自动提交，以文档为主：用 Excalidraw 重画推送流程与 Cloudflare Workers Builds 链路、新增运维索引，并实现 watchdog 兜底范围扩展到第二个 workflow、两条时间线各自计算。

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，并完成规范修订与可行性评估。发布先由 CI 通过 trusted publishing 与 OIDC 验证，随后依次发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0（改为带输出 Schema 的 JSON 结果）和 v1.2.0（修正分歧统计与 frontmatter 布尔解析）。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 从 v1.4.0 推进到 v2.0.0、v3.0.0 与 3.0.1。内容包括兼容 BOM 的原子 JSON 写入与代理重跑脚本助手、更完整的 agent 发现输出（含 `skippedBuiltins`）、`quota-math` 计价核算，以及 3.0.0 大幅精简文档；3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单并让 `check` 重新推导数字。

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 搭建 `knowledge/` 知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 实测和远程分支删除风险，并补充 AGENTS.md 约定。`sopen-translate` 做出 MV3 扩展，支持双语页面渲染、分块、熔断与进度、provider 预设和术语表流水线，之后移除划词翻译，加入 JSDoc 类型检查与冒烟测试。

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0，加入自动折行、溢出保护、中英双语命令行和 40 张示例画廊；因 Ark Pixel 韩文版不含谚文改用 Galmuri 字体。其余：`asset-inventory` 修正技能调用说明并发布 v1.15.4、v1.15.5，`myBlog` 补充 OpenChamber 截图样例，`meld-deepresearch` 增加双语运行流程图。

上游方面，`openchamber/openchamber` 有 23 次 issue 互动（存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片与文件视图缺陷），`anomalyco/opencode` 有 11 次（MiMo 视觉与图片输入失败、Windows CLI 入口、worktree 删除）。本期没有 PR 与评审记录。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 在 CI trusted publishing 发布候选版本后冻结了 skill_management 的 1.x 接口。
v3.0.0 把面向模型的文档从 104,181 字符压缩到 8,291 字符。
v0.3.0 加入支持中日韩的自动折行，并在溢出时按比例缩小字号。
v1.1.0 将四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象，并由声明的输出 Schema 校验。
提交缺陷：设置 > MCP 中缺少 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提交缺陷：mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对图片一律返回 400。
发起想法讨论：文件视图应能对选中代码评论，而不只是选中行号。
新开并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。

byRepo.text: 127 次本人提交，另有 713 次自动提交，6 次 issue 互动。文档方面用 Excalidraw 重画推送流程图、新增运维索引与 Workers Builds 看门狗说明，并实现看门狗兜底扩展到 30 天活动卡片 workflow。
77 次提交，4 个发布。实现 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable，修订规范，把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，统一 LF 换行，并发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0、v1.2.0。
80 次提交。从初始提交起步，搭建 `knowledge/` 知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 实测与远程分支删除风险，并补充 AGENTS.md 约定。
56 次提交。做出 MV3 扩展，支持双语页面渲染、分块、熔断与进度，加入 provider 协议层、预设与术语表流水线，随后移除划词翻译，补充 JSDoc 类型检查与冒烟测试。
29 次提交，2 个发布。加入自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先并附中文版的 README、40 张示例画廊，修正韩文字体，发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。
25 次提交，4 个发布。加入兼容 BOM 的原子 JSON 写入与代理重跑脚本助手，扩展 agent 发现输出，在 `quota-math` 中实现计价核算，发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 与 3.0.1。
0 次提交，23 次 issue 互动。报告 MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图行选择、上下文面板占比、截图分辨率与模型切换等缺陷，并发起代码选中评论、共享会话归档状态等想法讨论。
0 次提交，11 次 issue 互动。报告 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 视觉与图片输入失败、子代理 model_coming_soon 错误、Windows 缺少 CLI 入口，并评论 worktree 删除恢复问题。
6 次提交。修正技能、样例、指南与贡献文档中的技能调用说明，修复日文本地化，并发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5。
4 次提交。补充 OpenChamber 桌面、面板与移动端截图样例，以及会话保留提示截图。
2 次提交。新增中英双语手绘 Excalidraw 运行流程图，拆成英文与中文场景并接入 README。
